chapter: Town Hall, Vanguard and large works
title: Monterey, second year: told to get off the stage
summary: After John Handy's set ran long, a stagehand told Mingus to cut it short, so he played one tune.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah, he did. Anyway, that's a great record. The -- let me ask you about some music that I know very well, that I -- you had an enormous success in Monterey the first year, and when you went back out to California to do Monterey the second year, through -- well, you might tell the circumstances of that second year. But you had some extraordinary music to play. And the result was that you didn't play it there, at Monterey.
Why don't you say what happened then?
I can't say what happened. I don't know what happened.
Well, the way I heard it, that they kept you waiting forever while George Handy was on, or something like that. And you finally got on --
John Handy, right. And when you finally got on, it was so late that the people were leaving and you got angry, or something like that.
No, I didn't pay attention to the people. Somebody in the backstage, just told me to get off.
I remember, it was a redhaired, freckle-faced guy. To cut it short and get off. So I played one tune and got off.
See, I never heard that before.
